fields.label: File URL
fields.description: URL cua tep trong Frappe - khoa noi ban ghi nay voi dong File.

fields.label: SharePoint URL
fields.description: Duong dan mo tren Word Online. PHAI la Small Text chu khong phai Data: Graph tra ve URL da URL-encode ten tep, ma moi ky tu tieng Viet co dau no ra 9 ky tu (o-moc-nang -> %E1%BB%A3). Mot ten tep tieng Viet binh thuong da vuot nguong 140 cua Data - do that 14/09 la 190 ky tu.

fields.label: Link chia se
fields.description: Link do createLink(scope=users) tra ve. Quyen cap cho nguoi trong luong GAN VAO LINK NAY, khong phai vao sp_web_url (URL goc cua tep trong thu vien). Nguoi khong co quyen san trong thu vien - vi du nguoi gui phieu - chi mo duoc tep qua link nay (do 23/09, EC-CTR-2026-00019).

fields.label: He thong tai len luc
fields.description: Moc thoi gian cua LAN TA TU TAI LEN. Phai co truong RIENG nay: `sp_last_modified` la moc sua tren SharePoint, ma chinh lan tai len cua he thong cung ghi de no - nen neu lay mot minh no di so voi moc duyet thi moi phieu dong bo sau khi da co cap duyet deu bi bao nham (15/09: 5/5 bang canh bao dang hien deu SAI). Canh bao chi dung khi tep doi SAU moc nay, tuc do NGUOI sua chu khong phai ta.

fields.label: Lan sua gan nhat tren SharePoint
fields.description: Doc tu Graph. So voi thoi diem tung cap duyet de biet tep co doi sau khi duyet khong.

fields.label: Da cap quyen cho
fields.description: Danh sach email da duoc cap quyen sua, cach nhau dau phay.
